item.title: [+1] Rupee Nears Record Low Even as RBI Signals Further Tightening
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 44 reports from Bloomberg.com, Reuters, The New Indian Express and 31 more. Related: “Rupee risks more losses after post-RBI policy slide, higher oil adds to woes”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 6 Oct).

Pharma & healthcare: mild tailwind (+1) — Pharma exporters gain

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −3, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
